groups.label: Carbon atoms
groups.description: The two carbon atoms, which are sp-hybridised. The two sp hybrid orbitals of each carbon form the C–C and C–H σ bonds; the two unhybridised 2p orbitals form the two π bonds.

groups.label: Hydrogen atoms
groups.description: The two terminal hydrogen atoms. Each is bonded to one carbon by a σ bond (sp–1s overlap).

groups.label: C≡C triple bond
groups.description: Three cylinders between the carbons indicate a bond order of 3: one σ bond (sp–sp) and two π bonds (p–p). The cylinders do not correspond one-to-one to orbitals. Bond order 3, length 1.20 Å, shorter than C=C (1.34 Å) and C–C (1.54 Å).

groups.label: C–H bonds
groups.description: Two single σ bonds, one at each end of the molecule, each 1.06 Å long.

groups.label: sp hybrid orbitals
groups.description: Lobes of the sp hybrid orbitals. Each carbon has two, in a straight line at 180°; they form the σ bonds.

groups.label: 1st π bond
groups.description: One π bond: sideways overlap of one pair of unhybridised p orbitals, with lobes on both sides of the axis.

groups.label: 2nd π bond
groups.description: The second π bond, from the other pair of p orbitals. The axis of its lobes is perpendicular to the axis of the lobes of the 1st π bond.

groups.label: Plane 1
groups.description: Contains the C–C axis. It is a symmetry plane of the molecule and also the nodal plane of one of the two π bonds: the π-electron density is zero in this plane. Perpendicular to Plane 2.

groups.label: Plane 2 (stripes)
groups.description: Contains the C–C axis. It is a symmetry plane of the molecule and also the nodal plane of one of the two π bonds: the π-electron density is zero in this plane. Perpendicular to Plane 1.

groups.label: Hydrogen atoms
groups.description: The two hydrogen atoms at the ends of the molecule.

groups.label: x, y, z axes
groups.description: Coordinate axes. The molecular axis is the C–C axis.

groups.label: sp lobes
groups.description: Lobes of the sp hybrids: each carbon has two sp hybrid orbitals pointing in opposite directions (180°), which give the linear geometry.

groups.label: Molecular axis C∞
groups.description: The principal axis. Rotation by any angle about it leaves the molecule unchanged.

groups.label: Other axes
groups.description: Two of the infinitely many C₂ axes: perpendicular to the molecular axis, passing through the midpoint of C≡C.

groups.label: σh plane
groups.description: Symmetry plane perpendicular to the C∞ axis, at the midpoint of the C≡C bond. Solid fill.

groups.label: σv1 plane (stripes)
groups.description: Symmetry plane containing the C∞ axis. It is also the nodal plane of one π bond.

groups.label: σv2 plane (dots)
groups.description: A second plane containing the axis, perpendicular to σv1. It is the nodal plane of the other π bond.

groups.label: σ-bond regions
groups.description: Regions of end-on (axial) overlap along the internuclear axis. Ethyne has three σ bonds: one C–C and two C–H.

groups.label: sp hybrid orbitals
groups.description: Lobes of the sp hybrid orbitals. Each carbon atom has two, in a straight line at 180°. The σ bonds are formed from these.

groups.label: π bonds
groups.description: The two π bonds, formed by sideways overlap of the unhybridised p orbitals of the two carbons. The two pairs of p orbitals overlap sideways in mutually perpendicular directions and, together with the C–C σ bond, form the triple bond.

groups.label: Plane 1
groups.description: Contains the C–C axis. It is a symmetry plane of the molecule and also the nodal plane of one of the two π bonds: the π-electron density is zero in this plane. Perpendicular to Plane 2. Shown with a solid outline.

groups.label: Plane 2 (stripes)
groups.description: Contains the C–C axis. It is a symmetry plane of the molecule and also the nodal plane of one of the two π bonds: the π-electron density is zero in this plane. Perpendicular to Plane 1. Shown with stripes and an outline.

groups.label: Hydrogen atoms
groups.description: The two hydrogen atoms at the ends of the molecule. The molecule is linear: H–C≡C–H.

groups.label: sp and p labels (3D)
groups.description: The letters sp and p as 3D geometry. A screen reader does not read them; the same names appear in this list.

groups.label: x, y, z axes
groups.description: Coordinate axes. The molecular axis is the C–C axis.

groups.label: C–C σ bond
groups.description: The two sp³ lobes pointing towards each other along the C–C axis. Their end-on (axial) overlap is the σ bond, common to all three molecules; in ethane it is the only bond between the carbons (single bond).

groups.label: sp³ hybrids towards H
groups.description: The remaining sp³ hybrid orbitals: three on each carbon, one for each C–H σ bond.

groups.label: Hydrogen atoms
groups.description: The hydrogen atoms (spheres). Each is bonded to one carbon by a σ bond: overlap of a hybrid orbital with the hydrogen 1s orbital.

groups.label: Letters σ, π, H as 3D geometry
groups.description: The letters of the original model, modelled as 3D objects. They are hidden by default: a screen reader does not read them, and the same names appear in this list.

groups.label: Coordinate axes
groups.description: Three perpendicular axes with arrows at each carbon; one coincides with the C–C axis. The axis letters of the original model are not shown, because they were not the same in the three models.

groups.label: C–C σ bond
groups.description: The two sp² lobes pointing towards each other along the C–C axis. Their end-on (axial) overlap is the σ bond, common to all three molecules; together with the π bond, it forms the C=C double bond.

groups.label: sp² hybrids towards H
groups.description: The remaining sp² hybrid orbitals: two on each carbon, one for each C–H σ bond.

groups.label: π bond (p orbitals)
groups.description: The two unhybridised 2p orbitals, one on each carbon, perpendicular to the molecular plane. The lines between them show the sideways overlap above and below the plane: this is the π bond.

groups.label: Hydrogen atoms
groups.description: The hydrogen atoms (spheres). Each is bonded to one carbon by a σ bond: overlap of a hybrid orbital with the hydrogen 1s orbital.

groups.label: 1st π bond

groups.label: 2nd π bond (stripes)
groups.description: The second π bond: the other pair of 2p orbitals, in front of and behind the axis, perpendicular to the 1st π bond.
